original_target.title: A universal central limit law for quantum-graph nodal surplus

scope_comparison: The retained Holden construction refutes the Gaussian part but has variance asymptotically proportional to cycle rank; the local page explicitly retains universal variance bounds as the remaining target. Existing31Lean results are supporting finite/probabilistic statements, not a full formalization of that counterexample or of universal variance. Discrete signed-matrix nodal examples do not settle metric Kirchhoff variance. No new complete resolution of the remaining variance question located.
